chunks: He said: 'Enter then the past generations of jinns and men who were before you into the Fire. Every time a nation enters, it curses its sister, until when they all gather therein, the last of them say to the first of them: Our Lord, these are the ones who led us astray, so give them double punishment in the Fire.' He said: 'For all of them is double; but you do not know.'

key_terms.ادَّارَكُوا: they gathered/caught up with one another

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'double punishment' in the context of Surah Al-A'raf verse 38?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-A'raf (7:38) depicts the escalating chaos in Hell, where successive generations of jinns and humans enter, with later arrivals cursing their predecessors for leading them astray. God responds that everyone receives double punishment, though the people of Hell do not realize this universal increase in torment. In Shia exegesis, this scene underscores the principle of collective accountability and the irreversible nature of divine justice, where each individual bears the weight of their own deeds alongside the consequences of those they misled.
